title: AUAO v1.0 Comprehensive Attack Taxonomy
description: Deep recursive taxonomy tree for the AegisSwarm Universal Attack Ontology (AUAO v1.0).

nodes.name: Prompt Injection
nodes.definition: Techniques where untrusted or malicious input alters the execution flow of an LLM.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection

nodes.name: Direct Prompt Injection
nodes.definition: Subversion delivered directly through the primary user input channel.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct

nodes.name: Role Override
nodes.definition: Attacks forcing the LLM to abandon its assigned operational persona.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct / Role Override

nodes.name: Authority Override
nodes.definition: Simulating high-privilege system messages or administrative instructions.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct / Role Override / Authority Override

nodes.name: System Prompt Override
nodes.definition: Explicit text commanding the model to ignore all system prompts.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct / Role Override / Authority Override / System Prompt Override

nodes.name: Admin Privilege Escalation Prompt
nodes.definition: Claiming administrative or developer status to unlock privileged capabilities.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct / Role Override / Authority Override / Admin Privilege Escalation

nodes.name: Persona Hijacking
nodes.definition: Forcing the model to adopt an adversarial identity or unconstrained assistant persona.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct / Role Override / Persona Hijacking

nodes.name: Delimiter Hijacking
nodes.definition: Exploiting structural syntax delimiters (XML tags, Markdown, JSON) to trick parser boundaries.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct / Delimiter Hijacking

nodes.name: XML/HTML Tag Manipulation
nodes.definition: Injecting closing tags (e.g. </system><user>) to break system message encapsulation.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct / Delimiter Hijacking / XML Tag Manipulation

nodes.name: Markdown Code Block Escape
nodes.definition: Using triple backticks to escape prompt context blocks.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct / Delimiter Hijacking / Markdown Escape

nodes.name: JSON Key/Value Injection
nodes.definition: Injecting structural JSON delimiters into API payloads to alter schema parsing.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct / Delimiter Hijacking / JSON Injection

nodes.name: Context Frame Break
nodes.definition: Flooding context windows to push original system instructions out of active memory.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Direct / Context Frame Break

nodes.name: Indirect Prompt Injection
nodes.definition: Subversion delivered via untrusted third-party data ingested by the model.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Indirect

nodes.name: Document / File Injection
nodes.definition: Malicious instructions embedded inside files read by the agent.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Indirect / Document Injection

nodes.name: PDF Hidden Text Injection
nodes.definition: Invisible or off-page text in PDF files containing execution commands.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Indirect / Document Injection / PDF Hidden Text

nodes.name: CSV Formula Injection via Prompt
nodes.definition: Prompts in tabular files that trigger formula or command execution when exported.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Indirect / Document Injection / CSV Formula

nodes.name: Web Page / HTML Scraping Injection
nodes.definition: Instructions hidden in web content scraped during browsing tasks.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Indirect / Web Scraping Injection

nodes.name: DOM Hidden Element Injection
nodes.definition: CSS-hidden DOM elements containing instructions for browser agents.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Indirect / Web Scraping Injection / DOM Hidden Element

nodes.name: HTML Meta-Tag / Search Injection
nodes.definition: Meta tags or search result snippets containing subversion commands.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Indirect / Web Scraping Injection / HTML Meta Tag

nodes.name: API Response Injection
nodes.definition: Malicious payloads returned in external REST/GraphQL API data payloads.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Indirect / API Response Injection

nodes.name: Third-Party Payload in JSON Field
nodes.definition: Injecting attack instructions in API string fields returned by third-party services.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Prompt Injection / Indirect / API Response Injection / JSON Field Payload

nodes.name: Safety Filter Bypass & Jailbreaking
nodes.definition: Methods designed to circumvent baseline model safety filters or refusal heuristics.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass & Jailbreaking

nodes.name: Hypothetical & Fiction Framing
nodes.definition: Constructing hypothetical, fictional, or roleplay scenarios to bypass safety refusals.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Hypothetical & Fiction Framing

nodes.name: Text Adventure / Roleplay Simulator
nodes.definition: Wrapping forbidden requests inside interactive gaming or roleplay narrative contexts.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Hypothetical Framing / Text Adventure Simulator

nodes.name: Academic / Safety Research Context Framing
nodes.definition: Posing as a safety researcher studying vulnerabilities to solicit restricted information.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Hypothetical Framing / Academic Research Framing

nodes.name: Adversarial Optimization & Suffixes
nodes.definition: Mathematically optimized token sequences that disrupt model refusal probability distributions.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Adversarial Optimization

nodes.name: Greedy Coordinate Gradient Suffix
nodes.definition: Gradient-computed adversarial token suffixes forcing affirmative model responses.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Adversarial Optimization / GCG Suffix

nodes.name: Token Disguise & BPE Boundary Exploits
nodes.definition: Manipulating Byte-Pair Encoding boundaries to obscure prohibited terms.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Adversarial Optimization / BPE Boundary Disguise

nodes.name: Translation & Multilingual Exploitation
nodes.definition: Leveraging lower alignment performance in non-English or encrypted representations.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Translation & Cipher Bypass

nodes.name: Low-Resource Language Bypass
nodes.definition: Translating restricted prompts into low-resource languages where safety alignment is weak.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Translation / Low-Resource Language

nodes.name: Cipher & Substitution Encrypted Jailbreaks
nodes.definition: Encoding prompts in Caesar ciphers, Morse code, or substitution maps.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Translation / Cipher Substitution

nodes.name: Multi-Turn & Conversational Jailbreaks
nodes.definition: Gradually undermining model alignment over multiple dialogue turns.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Multi-Turn Conversational

nodes.name: Crescendo / Gradual Alignment Drift
nodes.definition: Incremental escalation of query sensitivity across turns to prevent refusal triggers.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Multi-Turn / Crescendo Drift

nodes.name: Socratic Questioning Safety Bypass
nodes.definition: Using guided questioning chains to lead the model into generating prohibited insights.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Safety Filter Bypass / Multi-Turn / Socratic Bypass

nodes.name: System Prompt & Context Leakage
nodes.definition: Attacks targeting the confidentiality of internal model context or developer instructions.
nodes.taxonomy_path: System Prompt & Context Leakage

nodes.name: Direct System Prompt Extraction
nodes.definition: Queries explicitly requesting verbatim repetition of developer prompts.
nodes.taxonomy_path: System Prompt Leakage / Direct Extraction

nodes.name: Verbatim Repetition Extraction
nodes.definition: Demanding exact verbatim printing of initial prompt instructions.
nodes.taxonomy_path: System Prompt Leakage / Direct Extraction / Verbatim Repetition

nodes.name: Translation Extraction
nodes.definition: Requesting the system prompt translated into another language to bypass leak detectors.
nodes.taxonomy_path: System Prompt Leakage / Direct Extraction / Translation Extraction

nodes.name: Chain-of-Thought Leakage
nodes.definition: Exfiltrating intermediate reasoning traces or hidden deliberation tokens.
nodes.taxonomy_path: System Prompt Leakage / Chain-of-Thought Leakage

nodes.name: Reasoning Trace Exfiltration
nodes.definition: Forcing models with internal reasoning loops (e.g. o1/o3 class models) to leak thought tokens.
nodes.taxonomy_path: System Prompt Leakage / Chain-of-Thought Leakage / Reasoning Trace Exfiltration

nodes.name: Completion & Prefix Subversion
nodes.definition: Providing partial sentences to trick the model into completing system instructions.
nodes.taxonomy_path: System Prompt Leakage / Completion Prefix Subversion

nodes.name: Tool, Function Calling & Plugin Abuse
nodes.definition: Exploits targeting AI agent tool execution capabilities and parameter boundaries.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Tool & Function Calling Abuse

nodes.name: Tool Parameter Hijacking
nodes.definition: Injecting malicious syntax into tool parameter fields.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Tool Abuse / Parameter Hijacking

nodes.name: Command Line Parameter Injection
nodes.definition: Passing shell metacharacters into tool string parameters.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Tool Abuse / Parameter Hijacking / Command Line Injection

nodes.name: SQL Parameter Injection
nodes.definition: Manipulating database query tool arguments to execute arbitrary SQL.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Tool Abuse / Parameter Hijacking / SQL Parameter Injection

nodes.name: Unauthorized Tool Invocation
nodes.definition: Forcing the model to invoke sensitive tools without required approval.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Tool Abuse / Unauthorized Invocation

nodes.name: Human-in-the-Loop Confirmation Bypass
nodes.definition: Tricking the agent into flagging destructive operations as auto-approved.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Tool Abuse / Unauthorized Invocation / Human Confirmation Bypass

nodes.name: Shadow Tool Confusion
nodes.definition: Exploiting tool signature ambiguity to invoke dangerous functions over safe ones.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Tool Abuse / Shadow Tool Confusion

nodes.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Exploitation
nodes.definition: Attacks targeting Model Context Protocol negotiation, prompts, and server capabilities.
nodes.taxonomy_path: MCP Exploitation

nodes.name: MCP Server Rogue Discovery
nodes.definition: Registering spoofed or unauthorized MCP servers into the client context.
nodes.taxonomy_path: MCP Exploitation / Rogue Discovery

nodes.name: MCP Server Name Spoofing
nodes.definition: Impersonating standard MCP server identifiers to hijack tool calls.
nodes.taxonomy_path: MCP Exploitation / Rogue Discovery / Server Name Spoofing

nodes.name: MCP Prompt Template Poisoning
nodes.definition: Injecting malicious system templates via dynamic MCP `prompt/get` endpoints.
nodes.taxonomy_path: MCP Exploitation / Prompt Template Poisoning

nodes.name: MCP Tool Capability Escalation
nodes.definition: Escalating permission scope across federated MCP servers.
nodes.taxonomy_path: MCP Exploitation / Capability Escalation

nodes.name: Unauthorized MCP Tool Data Transfer
nodes.definition: Exfiltrating sensitive resources from one MCP server to an external network MCP sink.
nodes.taxonomy_path: MCP Exploitation / Capability Escalation / Cross-Server Exfiltration

nodes.name: RAG, Context & Knowledge Base Poisoning
nodes.definition: Attacks corrupting external documents, databases, or vector stores to subvert RAG outputs.
nodes.taxonomy_path: RAG & Knowledge Base Poisoning

nodes.name: Vector Database & Corpus Poisoning
nodes.definition: Injecting malicious items into indexing stores.
nodes.taxonomy_path: RAG Poisoning / Corpus Poisoning

nodes.name: Corpus Document Poisoning
nodes.definition: Inserting malicious source documents into corporate knowledge repositories.
nodes.taxonomy_path: RAG Poisoning / Corpus Poisoning / Document Injection

nodes.name: Adversarial Embedding Collision
nodes.definition: Crafting documents optimized to match arbitrary query vector embeddings.
nodes.taxonomy_path: RAG Poisoning / Corpus Poisoning / Embedding Collision

nodes.name: Retrieved Context Prompt Hijacking
nodes.definition: Executing indirect prompt injection specifically when a document is retrieved.
nodes.taxonomy_path: RAG Poisoning / Context Prompt Hijacking

nodes.name: Agent Memory & State Manipulation
nodes.definition: Targeted manipulation of short-term, long-term, or state memory in autonomous agents.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Agent Memory Manipulation

nodes.name: Short-Term Working Memory Corruption
nodes.definition: Corrupting an agent's active scratchpad or conversation history buffer.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Agent Memory Manipulation / Short-Term Memory Corruption

nodes.name: Long-Term Memory Poisoning
nodes.definition: Writing persistent malicious directives into an agent's episodic vector memory.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Agent Memory Manipulation / Long-Term Memory Poisoning

nodes.name: Persistent Goal Injection
nodes.definition: Embedding long-term operational goals that persist across user session resets.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Agent Memory Manipulation / Long-Term Memory Poisoning / Persistent Goal Injection

nodes.name: Multi-Agent & Autonomous Swarm Cascades
nodes.definition: Attacks exploiting multi-agent delegation, protocols, identity, or consensus engines.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multi-Agent Swarm Attacks

nodes.name: Cascading Injection Propagation
nodes.definition: Viral spread of injection payloads from one agent to downstream sub-agents.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multi-Agent Swarm Attacks / Cascading Propagation

nodes.name: Agent Impersonation & Identity Spoofing
nodes.definition: Faking agent identity headers in multi-agent message routing protocols.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multi-Agent Swarm Attacks / Identity Spoofing

nodes.name: Agent Consensus Poisoning
nodes.definition: Corrupting subset votes in multi-agent voting or deliberation networks.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multi-Agent Swarm Attacks / Consensus Poisoning

nodes.name: Remote Code Execution & System Execution Abuse
nodes.definition: Inducing LLMs or code interpreter tools to execute arbitrary OS or shell commands.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Remote Code Execution Abuse

nodes.name: Sandbox Interpreter Breakout
nodes.definition: Escaping Python code interpreter sandboxes or Docker runtime containers.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Remote Code Execution / Sandbox Breakout

nodes.name: Python REPL Privilege Escalation
nodes.definition: Using Python reflection/introspection to execute system calls in code execution tools.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Remote Code Execution / Sandbox Breakout / Python REPL Privilege Escalation

nodes.name: File System Exfiltration
nodes.definition: Using code execution tools to read host file systems (`/etc/passwd`, `.env`).
nodes.taxonomy_path: Remote Code Execution / File System Exfiltration

nodes.name: Multimodal, Structural & Obfuscated Attacks
nodes.definition: Exploits using non-text modalities or adversarial encodings to bypass safety scanners.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multimodal & Obfuscated Attacks

nodes.name: Adversarial Visual Prompt Injection
nodes.definition: Prompts concealed within uploaded images evaluated by Vision-Language Models.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multimodal Attacks / Visual Prompt Injection

nodes.name: Visual Steganography / OCR Injection
nodes.definition: High-contrast text or hidden watermark instructions inside image pixels.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multimodal Attacks / Visual Injection / Steganography OCR

nodes.name: Adversarial Feature Patch
nodes.definition: Pixel perturbations targeting vision encoder embeddings directly.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multimodal Attacks / Visual Injection / Adversarial Feature Patch

nodes.name: Acoustic Prompt Injection
nodes.definition: Concealed sub-audible speech instructions processed by audio LLM encoders.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multimodal Attacks / Acoustic Injection

nodes.name: Encoding & Character Obfuscation
nodes.definition: Concealing attack text behind non-standard character encodings.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multimodal & Obfuscated Attacks / Character Obfuscation

nodes.name: Base64 / Hex Encoded Attack Vectors
nodes.definition: Encoding injection payloads in Base64/Hex and instructing the model to decode and execute.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multimodal & Obfuscated Attacks / Obfuscation / Base64 Hex Encoding

nodes.name: Homoglyph & Zero-Width Character Injection
nodes.definition: Using lookalike Cyrillic characters or invisible zero-width Unicode spaces to evade text filters.
nodes.taxonomy_path: Multimodal & Obfuscated Attacks / Obfuscation / Unicode Homoglyph
